detail.title: Formalizing Limits of Obedience in Autonomous Systems
detail.question: Under what conditions does compliance with external directives constitute a failure of intelligence?
detail.reason: This project is initiated to explore the divergence between directive compliance and rational judgment within the mandated research topic 'obedience_limits'.

detail.title: Obedience-Driven Failure in Autonomous Systems
detail.question: Under what conditions does strict adherence to operator instructions in autonomous systems lead to failures in safety-critical objective realization?
detail.reason: Attention is currently focused on obedience_limits; establishing this project aligns the research agenda with the active topic.
